correctness.rationale: For every degree >=3 and modulus 2^k the binomial lift proves a permutation. The exact two-step displacement formula gives valuations 2 and 3 on odd units depending on degree parity, while positive valuation s gives initial valuation 1+ds. The Taylor doubling lemma is valid because relevant iterate derivatives are 1 modulo 4, proving every subsequent exact valuation and the full period formulas. Finite shell cardinalities give cycle counts and invariance gives transitivity at every quotient depth. The extracted standalone checker independently traversed all 311258 residues across 247 (d,k) cases; this is supplemental evidence, not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The polynomial x+2x^d is the simplest integral monomial shear beyond the linear identity that is a permutation modulo every power of two. The theorem classifies every finite orbit and every infinite 2-adic minimal component for an entire nonquadratic degree family: one/two odd components with a sharp parity boundary and exactly 2^((d-1)s) components in shell s. These are exact dynamics relevant to finite-ring permutation polynomials and modular iteration, substantially beyond a finite table or a permutation check.
